notes.title: Update Notes – “Less Laziness, More Profit” Edition
notes.content:
[h3]🛍 [b]Update Notes – “Less Laziness, More Profit” Edition[/b][/h3][p]Dear Mall Managers,[/p][p]We’ve been digging through old saves, pumping your cashiers full of energy drinks, and giving the electronics store a much-needed boost. Here’s what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧯[b]Major Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Unclickable Boxes in Old Saves:[/b] Ever shouted “Why can’t I pick this up?!” at your screen? Same here. Now you can. Click = pickup.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 [b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Bigger Starting Balance:[/b] More cash in your pocket right from the start. Spend wisely—or recklessly. Your call.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shoppers Are Hungrier to Buy:[/b] We tweaked their spending mood a bit. Stock up, they’re coming.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Less Lazy Cashiers:[/b] They still grumble, but they’re a bit more like real employees now. That’s progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Earlier Cashier Unlock:[/b] No more waiting forever for help. You can hire sooner and stress less.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Electronics Store Tweaks:[/b] Small adjustments to make it run faster and earn better profits. Zzzzap! 💸[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 [b]Tiny Balance Tweaks[/b][/h3][p]Minor tuning behind the scenes. You might not notice it—but your mall definitely will.[/p][p]If chaos breaks loose (digitally), let us know. We’re watching.[/p][p]Happy managing,
[b]– The Mall Manager Simulator Dev Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Update Notes – “No More Thieves & Lazy Cashiers” Edition
notes.content: [h3]### 🛍 [b]Update Notes – “No More Thieves & Lazy Cashiers” Edition[/b][/h3][p]Dear Mall Managers,[/p][p]We’ve scrubbed the floors, re-trained the staff, and even kicked out a few troublemakers (literally). Here's what’s new:[/p][p]---[/p][h3]### 🧯[b]Major Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p]* Couldn't grab your precious deliveries? Neither could we... Fixed.[/p][p]* Cashier freezing like a popsicle mid-shift? Not anymore.[/p][p]* End-of-day statistics panel doing math like it skipped school? Now it passed.[/p][p]* Music randomly stopping and restarting like a confused DJ? Smoothed out.[/p][p]---[/p][h3]### 🛠 [b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b][/h3][p]* The Thief is Gone. Like... really gone. We removed them from your store and all other stores too. You’re welcome.[/p][p]* New Box Handling: Click once = box picked up and opened. Also: auto-stock on click. Click less, play more.[/p][p]* Store Opening Logic: Your mall won’t magically open and start running the clock until you open a store. You asked, we delivered.[/p][p]* Cashier Laziness Simulator™: Your cashier may now take short breaks, cross their arms, and mutter “I’m tired.” Upgrade their level to make them less moody.[/p][p]* Smarter Shoppers: Better movement, smoother box grabbing, and fewer shopper-Tetris pileups.[/p][p]---[/p][h3]### 🔧 [b]...And a Million Tiny Fixes[/b][/h3][p]We tested this update thoroughly and haven’t seen any major issues. But if your mall goes rogue again, let us know—we’re on it.[/p][p]Happy managing![/p][p]– The Mall Manager Simulator Dev Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🛠 Big Improvements Are Here! Community Feedback Update
notes.content: [h2]## 🛠 Big Improvements Are Here! Community Feedback Update 🛍[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Hey Managers![/b][/h3][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback – and we’re excited to roll out a major update packed with improvements, tweaks, and quality-of-life fixes that make *Mall Manager Simulator* more fun, fair, and fluid than ever![/p][p][/p][h3]### 🔧 [b]What’s New & Improved:[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]🤑 [b]Reworked Economy & Game Balance[/b][/h3][p]We've overhauled the in-game economy and polished the balancing across multiple systems. Progression now feels more rewarding, with smarter pacing and fewer bottlenecks.[/p][p][/p][h3]🕵️‍♂️ [b]The Thief Has Left the Building (For Now)[/b][/h3][p]Many of you told us the thief was more frustrating than fun – so we've temporarily removed them while we rethink how to make their presence feel engaging rather than annoying.[/p][p][/p][h3]📜 [b]Quest System Revamp[/b][/h3][p]Quests have been improved to better fit the gameplay flow. Objectives now feel more integrated and less intrusive – no more weird task interruptions![/p][p][/p][h3]✅ [b]General Fixes & Polish[/b][/h3][p]Tons of bug fixes and tweaks across the board based on your suggestions – thank you for helping shape the game![/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][h3]🚧 [b]And we’re not done![/b][/h3][p]We're already working on the next wave of updates with new features, gameplay depth, and content expansions – so stay tuned and keep the feedback coming![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thanks for supporting  Mall Manager Simulator[/b] 💙[/h3][p]— The Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Important Update Released!
notes.content:
🛠️ [h2][b]Important Update Released![/b][/h2]

Thank you so much for downloading and playing our game! 💖
We’ve listened to your feedback and made the following improvements in this update:

🔒 Simplified security guard management
🥤 Vending machines now restock automatically
🚽 Toilets are now restocked automatically
📦 New option to enable automatic product restocking
💾 Added a save button in the game
⚙️ General improvements to make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable

[h1]We hope you enjoy this update package and spend even more time in Mall Manager Simulator![/h1] 🛍️🎮

notes.title: Full Version Content
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

I'd like to inform you about what will be available in the full version:

[list]
[*] You will be able to open 4 additional stores: a Game Shop, a Music Instrument Store, a PC Parts Store, and a Pet Store.
[*] You can place vending machines in the mall.
[*] You will be able to decorate the mall hallways with decorative elements.
[*] You can open restrooms for guests to use.
[*] Elevators will be functional.
[*] The escalators will also work.
[*] You will need to catch thieves in the stores.
[*] You can hire staff: Sales Assistants, Security Guards, Cleaners, Toilet Paper Restockers, and Vending Machine Refillers.
[*] You will be able to move store furniture.
[*] You can monitor the shopping mall and the stores via a camera system.
[/list]

And much more!

We are making huge efforts to ensure that the game launches in excellent condition with rich content.
Add the game to your wishlist to stay updated on the release. See you soon!
